mapper.select: SELECT asset.* , ifnull(SUM(sub.SMV),0) UNINVEST_CASH, GREATEST(asset.UPDATE_TIME1,ifnull(asset.UPDATE_TIME2,asset.UPDATE_TIME1)) UPDATE_TIME FROM (SELECT sub.VAL_DATE POS_DATE, sub.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ASSET_CODE, info2.REP_CCY CCY, ifnull(SUM(sub.SECURITY_QUANTITY),0)*(case fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 when 'F01' then 100 else 1 end) POS_NUM, ifnull(SUM(sub.SMV),0) POS_AMT, sumsub.TOTAL_NUM TOTAL_NUM, max(ifnull(sub.CREATE_TIME,sub.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME1, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME2 FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub /*获取底层资产的公开市场代码*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info ON info.REP_FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*判断是否为债券*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*获取资管计划币种*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info2 ON info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID /*判断资管计划是否存在*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ifnull(SUM(SMV),0) TOTAL_NUM, VAL_DATE, PTL_ID, max(ifnull(CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB WHERE SUB_CODE = '601' GROUP BY VAL_DATE, PTL_ID ) sumsub ON sumsub.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = sumsub.PTL_ID WHERE 1 =1 AND sub.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND sub.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL --AND info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL and fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null GROUP BY sub.VAL_DATE, sub.PTL_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, sumsub.TOTAL_NUM, info2.REP_CCY, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME ) asset LEFT JOIN RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub ON sub.VAL_DATE = asset.POS_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND sub.SUB_CODE IN ('10020101','1031','1021') GROUP BY asset.POS_DATE, asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID, asset.ASSET_CODE, asset.POS_NUM, asset.POS_AMT, asset.TOTAL_NUM, asset.CCY, asset.UPDATE_TIME1, asset.UPDATE_TIME2

select distinct CDATE from ptl_sec_valution where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE AS POS_DATE, SUB.PTL_ID AS PLAN_ASSET_ID, SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV,0)) AS POS_AMT FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 活期存款、清算款、备付金、保证金**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002','1021','1031','3003') GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE,SUB.PTL_ID

SELECT HZ.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID, HZ.SUB_CODE ASSET_CODE, SUM(IFNULL(SMV,0)) POS_AMT FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB HZ WHERE HZ.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 实收资本、资产净值**/ AND HZ.SUB_CODE IN ('601', '701') GROUP BY HZ.PTL_ID,HZ.SUB_CODE

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE POS_DATE,/** 持仓日期**/ SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ 'CASH' ASSET_CODE,/** 行内资产/负债编码**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003') THEN IFNULL(SUB.SMV,0) ELSE 0 END) UNINVEST_CASH,/** 未投资头寸**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003') THEN IFNULL(SUB.SMV,0) ELSE 0 END) POS_NUM,/** 持仓数量**/ SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV,0)) POS_AMT, /** 底层资产折算人民币币值（元）**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('120401','120402','120403') THEN IFNULL(SUB.SMV, 0) ELSE 0 END) INT_AMT, /** 利息**/ MAX(IFNULL(SUB.CREATE_TIME, SUB.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 活期存款、清算款、备付金、保证金及其利息**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003','120401','120402','120403') GROUP BY SUB.PTL_ID

SELECT SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ COUNT(1) ASSET_CODE /** 其他科目数量**/ FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 除活期存款1002、清算款3003、应收银行活期存款利息120401**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1002%' /** 排除活期存款1002**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '3003%' /** 排除清算款3003**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '120401%' /** 排除应收银行活期存款利息120401**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2206%' /** 排除应付管理人报酬2206**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2207%' /** 排除应付托管费2207**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2209%' /** 排除应付交易费用2209**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2221%' /** 排除应付税费2221**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2222%' /** 排除预估税费2222**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2501%' /** 排除预提费用2501**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2801%' /** 排除其他应付款2801**/ GROUP BY SUB.PTL_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE POS_DATE,/** 持仓日期**/ SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ 'OD' ASSET_CODE,/** 行内资产/负债编码**/ SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV, 0)) POS_NUM,/** 持仓数量**/ SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV, 0)) POS_AMT, /** 底层资产折算人民币币值（元）**/ MAX(IFNULL(SUB.CREATE_TIME, SUB.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 应付管理人报酬2206+应付托管费2207+应付交易费用2209+应付税费2221+预估税费2222+预提费用2501+其他应付款2801**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('2206', '2207', '2209', '2221', '2222' ,'2501', '2801') GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE, SUB.PTL_ID ) ASSET WHERE POS_AMT > 0

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE POS_DATE,/** 持仓日期**/ SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ SUB.SUB_CODE ASSET_CODE, SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV,0)) POS_AMT, MAX(IFNULL(SUB.CREATE_TIME, SUB.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 上交所买入返售证券、银行间买入返售、深交所买入返售证券、应收买入返售证券利息 上交所卖出回购证券款、银行间卖出回购证券款、深交所卖出回购证券款、应付回购利息**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('120201','120202','120203','120410','220201','220202','220203','223101') GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE,SUB.PTL_ID,SUB.SUB_CODE

SELECT ASSET_CODE assetCode, CHECK_CODE checkCode, TARGET_AMT targetAmt, ASSET_TYPE2 assetType2, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket FROM CHB_ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1108','1902') AND STATUS IN ('E','M') AND #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} BETWEEN VDATE AND MDATE
